title: Gulf Coast Vacation Rental 30A Beach House with Private Pool
meta_description: Bali Zen is a 5-bedroom vacation home on Florida’s Gulf Coast. Enjoy a private pool, modern amenities, and easy beach access for your perfect Emerald Coast getaway. Book now!
description_expanded: AboutBali Zen | Luxury 30A Vacation Rental with Private Pool, Hot Tub and Backyard Oasis in Blue Mountain Beach Luxury 30A vacation rental in Blue Mountain Beach with a large private pool, private hot tub, backyard oasis, two living rooms, two kitchens, multiple balconies, and space for up to 16 guests. Welcome to Bali Zen, a spacious Blue Mountain Beach vacation rental on 30A designed for families and groups looking for a luxury Florida beach getaway close to the Gulf of Mexico, public beach access, restaurants, shopping, and everything that makes scenic Highway 30A one of Florida's most popular beach destinations. Located in Blue Mountain Beach along scenic 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida, Bali Zen combines the privacy of a luxury vacation home with resort-style outdoor living. Spend your days at the sugar-white sand beaches of the Emerald Coast, then return to your own large private swimming pool, hot tub, and tropical backyard retreat. With two separate living areas, two kitchens, multiple king bedrooms, bunk accommodations, spacious balconies, and plenty of room to spread out, this 30A vacation rental is an excellent choice for large families, multiple families, and group beach vacations. Why Guests Love This 30A Vacation Rental • Large private pool • Private hot tub • Beautiful backyard oasis with lush landscaping • Sleeps up to 16 guests • Blue Mountain Beach location along scenic 30A • Close to public beach access and the Gulf of Mexico • Two living rooms — ideal for large and multi-generational families • Two kitchens • Multiple spacious balconies • Gorgeous coastal luxury décor • Open-concept main living area • Outdoor grill • Plenty of parking • Free Wi-Fi • Four backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella • Close to 30A restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and local attractions • Golf cart rental savings: Guests of Bali Zen receive 10% off the rental rate of a street-legal golf cart if they choose to rent one during their stay. A golf cart is not included with the home. • Starbucks coffee, bottled water, and a thoughtfully stocked starter amenity package upon arrival Large Private Pool, Hot Tub & 30A Backyard Oasis The star of Bali Zen is its large private pool and secluded backyard oasis—a feature that makes this home stand out among 30A vacation rentals in Blue Mountain Beach. Surrounded by lush landscaping, the private outdoor space feels like your own tropical retreat. Spend sunny Florida afternoons swimming in the pool, relaxing poolside with family and friends, grilling outdoors, or unwinding in the private hot tub after a day at the beach. When you're traveling with a large group, having a private outdoor space can completely change the vacation experience. At Bali Zen, you can enjoy the excitement of 30A and Blue Mountain Beach and still come home to a peaceful backyard where your group can swim, relax, and spend time together. Two Living Rooms & Two Kitchens for Large Families and Groups Bali Zen was made for guests who want to vacation together without feeling crowded. With two living areas and two kitchens, the home offers exceptional flexibility for large families, extended families, and groups traveling together. The main second-floor living area is filled with natural light from large windows and features gorgeous vaulted wood ceilings, comfortable seating, a large flat-screen TV, and beautiful coastal décor. The open-concept floor plan connects the living room with the gourmet kitchen and dining area, creating an inviting gathering space for everything from morning coffee to family dinners. The main kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a farmhouse sink, generous counter space, and a beautiful butcher-block island. An adjacent dining table seats eight, providing plenty of room to gather for meals before heading back to the beach or pool. The indoor fireplace adds to the atmosphere of the living room but is decorative only and is not available for guest use. First Floor — Second Kitchen, Second Living Area and Pool Access The first floor gives your group even more room to spread out and is one of the features that makes Bali Zen particularly well suited for multi-family 30A vacations. This level includes a second kitchen and bonus living area with a flat-screen TV and additional twin beds. With convenient access to the patio and private pool, it makes a great secondary gathering space for kids, teens, or another family traveling with your group. A king bedroom with direct access to the pool area lets guests step outside and immediately enjoy the backyard and warm Florida coastal air. The second bedroom on this floor features a full bunk, providing a fun and comfortable sleeping area for children or additional guests. These bedrooms share a sleek, modern bathroom. Second Floor — Open-Concept Coastal Living The second floor is the heart of Bali Zen and provides the home's primary gathering space. In addition to the main living room, gourmet kitchen, and dining area, this level includes two additional bedrooms. A bunk suite with a private balcony provides comfortable accommodations and its own outdoor space, while a king suite with a balcony gives guests another relaxing private retreat. Large balconies and outdoor spaces throughout the home provide plenty of opportunities to enjoy morning coffee, afternoon breezes, and relaxing evenings along Florida's Emerald Coast. Third Floor — Private Primary Suite with Two Balconies Escape upstairs to the spacious third-floor primary suite, a peaceful retreat offering additional privacy from the home's main gathering areas. The primary suite features vaulted ceilings and two private balconies, creating a serene place to begin and end each day of your 30A vacation. The ensuite bathroom continues the home's spa-inspired atmosphere with a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and elegant finishes. After a full day at Blue Mountain Beach or an afternoon beside the private pool, this is the perfect place to relax and recharge. Blue Mountain Beach Vacation Rental Near the Beach Bali Zen is located in Blue Mountain Beach, one of the most loved communities along scenic Highway 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida. Guests can enjoy convenient access to the beautiful white-sand beaches and emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico, while also being close to local restaurants, shops, entertainment, and outdoor activities. Blue Mountain Beach is known for its relaxed coastal atmosphere and convenient location along 30A. From Bali Zen, guests can easily explore nearby Grayton Beach, Gulf Place, Santa Rosa Beach, Seaside, WaterColor, Seagrove Beach, and other popular 30A communities. Spend the morning at the beach, grab lunch at a local 30A restaurant, explore the shops and communities along scenic Highway 30A, and return to Bali Zen for an afternoon swim in your own private pool. Save 10% on a Street-Legal Golf Cart Rental Want a golf cart during your 30A vacation? Guests staying at Bali Zen receive 10% off the rental rate of a street-legal golf cart through our golf cart rental partner. A golf cart does not come with the home and is not included in the reservation, but this exclusive guest discount makes it easy to add one to your vacation if desired. Beach Gear and Thoughtful Starter Amenities Bali Zen includes four backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella, making trips to the beautiful beaches of 30A even easier. When you arrive, you'll also find Starbucks coffee, creamer, sugar, and bottled water, along with a starter supply of vacation essentials including paper towels, dish soap, a sponge, kitchen wipes, dishwasher detergent, laundry detergent pods, pillow spray, shampoo, conditioner, aloe, lotion, bathroom soaps, and a roll of toilet paper in each bathroom. Your Luxury 30A Beach Vacation Starts at Bali Zen If you're searching for a luxury 30A vacation rental with a private pool and hot tub, Bali Zen delivers the space, location, and amenities for an unforgettable Florida beach vacation. With a large private pool, backyard oasis, private hot tub, two living rooms, two kitchens, multiple balconies, accommodations for up to 16 guests, and a prime Blue Mountain Beach location near public beach access, Bali Zen gives families and groups the best of both worlds—a private luxury retreat and convenient access to everything guests love about 30A and the Emerald Coast. Spend your mornings along the sugar-white sands of Blue Mountain Beach, afternoons swimming in your private pool, evenings relaxing in the hot tub, and nights gathering with family and friends in this spacious 30A beach home. Book Bali Zen and experience your own private luxury retreat in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach on 30A. Pack less. Vacation more. Exterior Security Cameras: For the safety and security of the property and our guests, the home is equipped with exterior Ring security cameras. Cameras are located at the front entry facing the road, at the right-side entry facing the second driveway, above the garage facing the first driveway, and near the pool equipment. The camera near the pool equipment does not face, view, or monitor the swimming pool or pool area. All cameras monitor exterior areas only; there are no cameras located inside the home.
